* '''PC-E1''' ([[Black Krrsantan (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 22 release sheet<ref name="sheet22-20231006">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2023”; file created 6 October 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 22]] (2 October 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 6 October 2023: “Vibro-Ax deploys free on Krrsantan. Power +1 while defending a battle. If a battle was just initiated here, each player who has four or more characters present with Krrsantan must choose one to return to hand.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Black Krrsantan]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Black Krrsantan]] (published 2 October 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•Black Krrsantan”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
